name: files
notes: Chunk i of n: blob = seal(fileKey, plaintext[i*CHUNK, (i+1)*CHUNK), aad = passholder/v3/file/<id>/<i>/<n>), same blob format as entries (Base64(0x01 || nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16)), AES-256-GCM). Keys and nonces are hex. blobSha256 is the SHA-256 (hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of each Base64 blob string, not of the decoded bytes. A file with contentRule has no content: generate size bytes with byte[i] = (i * 31 + 7) & 0xff. Entry payloads are compact JSON in canonical key order (attachments between custom and hlc, descriptor keys id, name, mime, size, chunks, sha256, key). A merged entry is {...winner, attachments: mergeAttachments(winner, loser), hlc: merge.hlc}. Host steps run in order against one fresh store with the given epoch and now; storage steps use a separate store of the given capacity (sum of stored blob lengths). A step with expand has its request field replaced before sending: ids = count copies of repeat, blob = repeat repeated count times. Orphan: each file is one chunk stored at createdAt; expected ids are sorted (order is not significant).
